findings.claim: Original 0049C7F0 reciprocal-table initialization makes 0049CC20/0049CCA0 emit positive current-frame subdivisions; these helpers do not carry elapsed-time remainder across frames.
findings.limitations: Binary-static and original-instruction Ghidra execution for 16 controlled nonnegative finite dt/init combinations; GetTickCount and ftol are substituted. Actual WinMain scheduler not replayed.

findings.claim: Executing original 00493C50 seed-table initialization alone changes the reproduced bus and GTSi two-frame basis to near orthonormal; ftol stack-pop correction alone leaves the legacy non-unit bus basis unchanged.
findings.limitations: Controlled original-instruction emulation with substituted services, drive state and camera relevance. Near-unit Gram error approximately 8.6e-6, not exact orthonormality/hardware x87 parity or correct dynamics. PR49 source remains an unmerged candidate.

findings.claim: Original WinMain orders clock update before class pre/post and FSM callbacks; initialized timing permits positive-dt original 00438FD0 and 00440740 entry, but the guarded replay stops at 00493550 because mission terrain is unloaded.
findings.limitations: Ordering is static, not WinMain execution. Positive entry is not completed valid contact physics. Earlier unguarded downstream outputs read null terrain and are excluded. Mission terrain/height blocks, contact records and suspension completion remain unverified.
